Application Data.NAME: Nature's Best Health Foods, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Nature's Best Health Foods, Inc. operates as a retail health food and vitamin store, offering a wide range of FDA-approved dietary supplements, organic snacks, and natural personal care products. Our business emphasizes quality assurance with rigorous adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and all relevant FDA regulations. We maintain a secure e-commerce platform alongside our physical store, ensuring robust inventory controls and transparent return policies. Our commitment to customer education includes providing clear labeling and information on the health benefits of our products, fostering trust and compliance among our clientele. Additionally, we have established protocols for managing product liability and ensure our suppliers meet stringent certification standards, all while maintaining a minimal claims history.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a refrigeration unit failure caused product spoilage valued at $1,200. The loss was reported immediately, and all affected items were disposed of per regulatory guidelines. The claim was settled, and no further action is pending.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1 Safe, UL Listed, with electronic locking mechanism.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras, motion detectors, and trained staff on-site during operating hours to ensure product safety and loss prevention.
